purpose: Frozen synthesis requirements for the ci-cd-optimize rebuild. Each row maps a source (open PR or defect) to its destination and acceptance check. Decisions: adopt (take as-is conceptually), adapt (take with corrections), reject (do not carry forward).

pr_rows.contribution: Registration deadline, SHA pinning, diff-gated events, heartbeat, bounded API errors, failure log command; path-filter and checkout gotchas.
pr_rows.acceptance: Watcher implements registration deadline, diff-gated append-only events, heartbeats, bounded probe-error streak, and log hints; checkout filter/sparse composition is stated correctly (they compose; filter does not disable sparse).

pr_rows.contribution: Cancellation semantics (superseded only with proven newer tip), reusable-workflow startup_failure/zero-jobs diagnosis, pagination fail-closed, monitor timeout > watcher deadline.
pr_rows.acceptance: cancelled + proven newer tip => superseded; unproven tip => cancelled; startup_failure with zero jobs surfaces as run-level failure; incomplete enumeration never yields success.

pr_rows.contribution: Provider-neutral probe architecture, newest-run-per-workflow, settle window for late workflow_run, explicit success allowlists, run-ID state.
pr_rows.acceptance: Canonical probe envelope with closed state vocabulary; settle window resets on new units; empty generic probe output is never green.

pr_rows.contribution: BuildKit mode=max break-even, COPY --chown, planner self-routing, rename detection, per-test profiling before sharding, deployment convergence budgets, registry proxy vs store cache.
pr_rows.acceptance: Lessons present in destination references. Its watcher is NOT reused: current head crashes before terminal handling on repo-resolution failure (violates non-silent-exit).

pr_rows.contribution: Engagement sequence (read config/history before touching YAML; one bounded experiment; report disproved hypotheses), differentiated exit codes 0/1/2/3, A/B interleaving under contention.
pr_rows.acceptance: optimization-workflow.md owns the ordered engagement loop; watcher exit codes: success=0, failure/cancelled=1, timeout/no-run/probe-dead=2, superseded=3. Script placement at scripts/ (NOT references/scripts/ as in the PR).

pr_rows.contribution: Concise waiting-primitive taxonomy: streamed progress vs single-completion vs blocking gate; TTY redraw output unsuitable for event streams; every watcher needs a deadline and exactly one terminal verdict.
pr_rows.acceptance: feedback-loops.md contains the waiting-primitive selection table and single-terminal-verdict rule.

pr_rows.contribution: Job-hop cost model (each extra job adds queue+setup), job-level first-red events, supersession detectable before registration, run-ID inclusion for concurrent same-named runs, no silent 50-run truncation.
pr_rows.acceptance: First-red emitted immediately including on initial snapshot; supersession checked pre-registration; pagination complete; duplicate names disambiguated by IDs.

pr_rows.contribution: Most hardened watcher: duration validation (nan/inf/zero/negative), refreshed settle timing, explicit state vocabularies, deadline-bounded serial job expansion, branch-tip check before terminal return, error-streak reset on successful empty query.
pr_rows.acceptance: All listed validations present; implemented as a smaller tested state machine rather than a 490-line copy.

pr_rows.contribution: Fail-closed semantics: incomplete enumeration is not a verdict; --expect-none requires a proven empty result; unit names with '/' parsed correctly; mixture of success+cancelled/skipped is not green; malformed/unknown states fail closed.
pr_rows.acceptance: All fail-closed rules implemented and fixture-tested.

pr_rows.contribution: Larger runners can lose end-to-end via fleet queueing; time the uncached path first; platform registry proxies can make dependency caches redundant; genuine failure must not be hidden by later supersession; materialize generators before multi-pass aggregation.
pr_rows.acceptance: Prose lessons landed; watcher aggregates from materialized lists; red-then-branch-moved yields failure not superseded.

pr_rows.contribution: Capacity model with reviewer qualifications: queue share is a diagnostic signal not a gate; observed concurrency is a lower bound not a proven ceiling; merge-don't-split when extra jobs only add queue+setup; A/B under different pool load is not comparable.
pr_rows.acceptance: capacity-and-contention.md states both qualifications explicitly and requires repeated saturated observations per pool/class.

pr_rows.contribution: Content map only. Broadest rewrite but 11 active unresolved defects at head; every defect becomes a negative requirement below.
pr_rows.acceptance: No file copied from the #85 head; all 11 defect rows below pass.

defect_rows.defect: Nonzero custom probe with partial output accepted
defect_rows.requirement: Nonzero probe exit invalidates all stdout from that invocation.

defect_rows.defect: Concurrent same-named workflow jobs overwrite each other
defect_rows.requirement: Keys are (provider, repo, run_id, run_attempt, job_id); names never used as keys.
Every runnable example defines its variables; change-based-ci examples derive base/head explicitly and fail to full-run on diff error.
All documented watcher invocations use only flags the script actually accepts; contract test greps docs for unknown flags.
Exit classes differentiated: 0 success, 1 failure/cancelled, 2 timeout/no-run/probe-dead, 3 superseded.
interval/heartbeat must be finite and > 0; registration/settle >= 0; deadline > 0; nan/inf rejected.

defect_rows.defect: Probe+sleep could exceed a short hard deadline
defect_rows.requirement: Every subprocess timeout and sleep is bounded by remaining overall time.

defect_rows.defect: Job key namespace changed when a run completed
defect_rows.requirement: Unit keys are stable across active->completed transitions; no spurious re-registration.
Description starts with the approved prefix and is <= 30 words; enforced by validator and contract test.
Examples do not pin stale action versions; version-sensitive pins carry a verify-current note.

defect_rows.defect: README description did not follow repository derivation rules
defect_rows.requirement: README description equals frontmatter description with trigger prefix removed; enforced by contract test.
